Before creating a issue, please read this.

Issues are used to report problems, request features, inform about a misbehavior of the firmware or inform missing information.

If you have a question, need help in one step or something related. Issues are not the place. The correct place is the telegram chat https://t.me/protopandachat

Anything can go there related to problems, questions, reports, etc.
If you read everything, add the word cake somwehre in your issue.

Remove everything above and this phrase before opening a issue.
